reason: brief P6a: the position of the filter line (parameter offset) is set on desktop only by dragging the line on the photo (graduatednd.c mouse_moved / button_released: _set_grad_from_points). Here it is a slider after rotation. darktable's introspection gives offset no limits ($MIN/$MAX not declared: -FLT_MAX..FLT_MAX), so the slider takes 0..100 %, the values a line with rotation 0 takes from the top to the bottom edge of the picture (offset = 100 x the line's height there); desktop's default 50 is the centre. A turned line can reach a little beyond (about -20.7..120.7 at 45 degrees), which only the on-photo line gives on desktop.

add_slider.label: offset
add_slider.tooltip: position of the filter line: 0 % at the top edge, 50 % through the centre, 100 % at the bottom edge (for rotation 0)
